summary: Ultrapar Participações S.A., the Brazilian issuer of Ultrapar Holdings Inc., filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Board-approved share buyback program for up to 18,000,000 common shares (1.61% of outstanding capital) over 12 months starting June 18, 2026. Shares will be repurchased on the open market via B3 and may be used for stock-based incentive plans, held in treasury, canceled, or sold. The company may employ swap derivatives with a 12-month term, financial settlement, and potential collateral requirements for net exposures. The filing includes specified free float (1.07bn shares) and treasury holdings (44.86mn shares). Watch for execution pace and potential cancellation impact on shareholder value.
